reason: I've never heard of them, and I'd screenshot that cloud pendant into Google Lens and probably find the same thing on AliExpress or Amazon for half. $360 plus a 10 to 12 business day wait from an unknown store isn't enough to make me stop looking.
objection: 10 to 12 business days is a long wait for a light, and I can't tell if this is a real brand or a reseller of the same factory pendant I can get cheaper elsewhere. Return shipping on a big fragile pendant is on me if I change my mind.
would_change_my_mind: Proof it isn't a rebadged marketplace item (real reviews, photos from actual customers), a price clearly below what Lens turns up for the same piece, and free returns or faster in-stock shipping.
